name: scenario
value: Does the business know who acts when the system is disrupted?

name: method
value: The baseline is 1.5 core hours plus 24% rework at 2.2 hours per instance. Up to five of ten assumed steps can be removed. Digital uptake and simplification affect core time; rework is modelled separately.

name: formula
value: Baseline = 1.5 + 0.24 × 2.2 hours; new core = 1.5 × (1−0.065 × steps) × (1−0.36 × digital uptake); new total = core + rework × 2.2; annual hours released = (baseline−new total) × monthly cases × 12.

name: limits
value: All coefficients and the BDT 650/hour valuation are synthetic. Time opportunity value is not a cash saving or budget reduction. Negative released hours mean workload increased.
